name: hbm_loader_half_4d30522ee-cgfix-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): hbm_loader_half_4d30522ee-cgfix re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: SETUP-TRIAGE requeue of hbm_loader_half_4d30522ee (SS -603.52 / FF 14.6): class A/B flow fixes only (clock-gate push-down with latch cloning, CTS-net dont_touch before repair, fixed SDC patterns) + flow-hold mm hold repair; source = origin/main + setup-triage fixes, no RTL change by this stream.

bench.name: exact_ldm_half
bench.cmd: bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/run_ldm_half.sh {RUN}/bench 2>&1 | grep -v Aborted | tee {RUN}/bench.txt; grep -q 'LDM_HALF PASS' {RUN}/bench.txt

bench.name: neg_nogate_and_foh
bench.cmd: grep -q 'neg_nogate detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && grep -q 'neg_foh detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && echo LDM_NEG_FAIL && exit 1; exit 0
